sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180031
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 33036 of 2023
Applicant :- Shiv Veer

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Sanjay Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Dr. S.B. Maurya, learned Aga-I
for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 115 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Lavedi,
District Etawah during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his two family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the deceased on 22.04.2015 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured the deceased for want of motorcycle and golden chain and on 20.09.2021 informant received an information that deceased i.e. his daughter has died.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation of demand of dowry and torture made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and only being husband, applicant Shiv Veer vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92114243/
1 has been made accused in the present matter.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that deceased was stubborn lady and due to her bad behavior she committed suicide.

He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 23.09.2021 i.e. for almost two years.
5.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is husband of the deceased and as per the viscera report deceased died due to consumption of poison, therefore, it appears that wife of the applicant died under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home within seven years of her marriage and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and applicant failed to explain the death of his wife, therefore, he should not be released on bail.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

7. Although, applicant is in jail since September, 2021 i.e. for almost two years but his wife died under abnormal circumstances within seven years of her marriage in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.

8. From the post mortem report, it appears that cause of death could not be ascertained, therefore,
viscera was preserved but as per viscera report, which has been filed by the State in the counter affidavit, it appears that deceased died due to consumption of poison i.e. insecticide.

Further,
applicant failed to explain the abnormal death of his wife, therefore, in my view, applicant, who is husband, is not entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

10. However, considering the fact that applicant is in jail for almost two years, trial court is directed to conclude the trial of the case within a period of eight months from the date of production of certified copy of this order in accordance with law, if there is no legal impediment.

11. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 AK Pandey  Shiv Veer vs State Of U.P. on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92114243/
